description: Cummins Inc., founded in 1919 as Cummins Engine Company in Columbus, Indiana as one of the first diesel engine manufacturers and renamed Cummins Inc. in 2001, is a global power leader committed to powering a more prosperous world. Since 1919 it has delivered innovative solutions that move people, goods and economies forward, and its five reportable segments, Engine, Components, Distribution, Power Systems and Accelera, offer a broad portfolio including advanced diesel, electric and hybrid powertrains, integrated power generation systems, critical components such as aftertreatment, turbochargers, fuel systems, controls, transmissions, axles and brakes, and zero emissions technologies like battery and electric powertrain systems, with a global footprint, deep technical expertise and an extensive service network supporting customers through the energy transition with its Destination Zero strategy.
